title: One command. One source. One verified presentation.
subtitle: AI operates. Drive preserves. GitHub versions. Actions verifies. Pages presents.

entries.label: AI orchestration
entries.purpose: Natural-language instructions · authority resolution · permitted tool orchestration
entries.boundary: AI is an operator, not a source of truth or a substitute for provider readback

entries.label: GitHub Actions
entries.purpose: Python jobs · builds · tests · QA · publishing
entries.boundary: Only verifies what the workflow actually checks

entries.label: GitHub Pages
entries.purpose: Approved public dashboards · viewers · AAD displays
entries.boundary: Publication alone is not data or engineering approval

entries.label: Google Drive
entries.boundary: Preserves source files; not a code version-control replacement

entries.label: GitHub Issues + Projects
entries.purpose: Backlog · defects · milestones · AI work tickets
entries.boundary: Issues describe intentions, not completed implementation

entries.label: Supabase
entries.boundary: Adopt only when a live, permissioned database is needed

entries.label: Vercel
entries.boundary: Not needed merely to publish the existing static Atlas

principle: Git records the change → Actions tests explicit rules → Drive retains original evidence → a database manages live application state when required.
example: An IFC parser passing means the file parsed; it does not approve the structural design.
actions_hint: Actions can also run geometry inspection, Python engineering calculations, spreadsheet validation, quantity takeoffs, reproducibility manifests and report assembly—only after the scripts and evidence checks are implemented.

architecture_poster.semantic_title: ONE COMMAND. ONE SOURCE. ONE VERIFIED PRESENTATION.
architecture_poster.subtitle: AI operates. Drive preserves. GitHub versions. Actions verifies. Pages presents.
architecture_poster.motto: THE WEBSITE IS THE WINDOW, NOT THE SOURCE OF TRUTH.

input.label: USER COMMAND
input.description: Describe the task naturally; permission and scope still apply

commander.label: AI ORCHESTRATION
commander.description: Resolve owners, plan, execute permitted tools and record readback. The AI is not independent authority.

sources.label: GOOGLE DRIVE
sources.caption: Original documents, drawings and governed evidence

sources.label: GITHUB
sources.caption: Versioned scripts, schemas, templates and designated structured truth

execution.label: GITHUB ACTIONS
execution.description: Build · generate · test · validate · release QA (only the tests actually implemented)

outputs: Authorized links to original Drive files
architecture_poster.authority_disclaimer: File ownership is determined by fact class, module contract and original provider—not a universal rule that every file is in Drive or every structured fact is in Git.
architecture_poster.privacy_disclaimer: Public Pages cannot publish private originals, restricted metadata, secret IDs or unauthorized answers. Drive file access remains governed by Drive permissions.
architecture_poster.automation_disclaimer: This is an operating architecture, not evidence that automatic Drive → GitHub → Pages ingestion or role-based private websites are installed.
architecture_poster.proof_disclaimer: An Actions PASS confirms only its specified checks; engineering approval and signed/legal status require separate evidence.

source_notes: A7 reference/curation only. Specific fact class, module and original provider decide authority; no cross-system migration or automation asserted.
